findings.note: The declared test sources contain only structural no-flag checks and do not contain the claimed TEST-011 byte-for-byte comparison against the committed v1 golden fixtures. This contradicts the 51-test remediation logs and leaves AC-011 unverified by the bundled implementation.

Supplying capability-block-id without capability-enforcement reaches an additional usage-error branch that is neither specified in AC-033's exhaustive flag-combination contract nor exercised by either test twin. The implementation therefore exposes undocumented and unverified CLI behavior.
